summary_paraphrase: A wordless book: a boy who does not want to go to the library opens a book and travels through it, from a dinosaur's land to the sea, to space and on an eagle's back, before finding himself back on the library floor and walking home delighted.

characters.name: (unnamed boy)
characters.desire: (inferred) not to be at the library; then to explore
characters.change: from sulking to delight in books

characters.name: (unnamed woman)
characters.relation_to_protagonist: (inferred) carer or parent; brings him and takes him home

characters.name: dinosaur
characters.relation_to_protagonist: first creature met; ambiguous (friendly, then frowning)

humor_notes: Little humour; the dinosaur's frown as he runs off the page edge is the one comic beat.

repetition.description: opening and closing walk with the same hand-hold, mood reversed
repetition.why: the frame makes the change visible without words

repetition.description: open books on the floor and thought bubbles recap the dinosaur, fish and rocket
repetition.why: invites retelling: the child can name each world

notes: Wordless: every page's information is in the picture, so all page-turn effects are visual.
Each world dissolves into the next through a shared shape (book edge, starfish into stars, feathers into floor).

strengths: transitions between worlds are built from shapes, so each turn has a small surprise
clear bookend: the change is shown by the same walk drawn twice
weaknesses: no problem or goal drives the journey; the arc is mood only
the dinosaur's frown and the shark shadow are left unexplained

anti_patterns.note: nothing can be lost on the journey; intentional for a dream-journey, but it lowers tension

child_appeal_heuristic.label: Research heuristic — not validated
child_appeal_heuristic.rationale: Scores are the analyst's reading of the pages, not observations of children. Participation scored for wordless retelling.

age_suitability.notes: Wordless. A shark shadow and a fall from the sky appear, both drawn unthreatening and immediately resolved.

metrics.lexicon_note: direct_address and sound_words are lexicon counts: a floor, not a measure. direct_address counts second-person words anywhere, dialogue included — it is not narrator-to-reader address

repetition.end_rhyme_note: heuristic: consecutive lines sharing a final two letters
